row: Pet Vet Care Hotel and Clinic Veterinary Clinic

At Pet Vet Care Hotel and Clinic your pet gets all the care it deserves, thanks to our comfortable and homely boarding facilities and always cheerful staff. Going for vacations ? There's no better place than this to board your pet, plus our expert doctors are always there to provide solutions for your pets illness or disease. For the finest medication and boarding for your pets, come see us today ! At Bird Market, Souq Waqif, Doha.
